pokemon_scp.name: Starmie
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0121 is to be contained in a reinforced aquatic vault with psychic dampeners and gem-frequency scramblers. Personnel must avoid direct exposure to SCP-0121’s central core.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0121 is a star-shaped organism whose central gem emits high-frequency psychic pulses capable of disrupting cognition and short-term memory. Limbs rotate independently, allowing rapid movement and unpredictable attack patterns.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Silent and reactive. Moves toward electromagnetic sources and attempts to interface with them.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0121-A: Gem pulse caused temporary amnesia in two researchers.
Addendum 0121-B: SCP-0121 attempted to synchronize with facility power grids.

pokemon_scp.name: Mr. Mime
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0122 is to be contained in a performance-grade chamber with barrier integrity sensors. Personnel must avoid entering SCP-0122’s invisible constructs.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0122 can generate invisible barriers composed of condensed psychic force. Barriers exhibit physical properties comparable to reinforced glass and can appear without warning.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Eccentric and theatrical. Communicates through gestures and mimed actions.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0122-A: SCP-0122 trapped a guard inside an invisible cube for 14 minutes.
Addendum 0122-B: Barrier composition shows fractal psychic lattice structures.

pokemon_scp.name: Scyther
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0123 is to be contained in a high-speed aerial combat vault with automated tranquilizer turrets. Personnel must not enter without full hazard armor.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0123 possesses scythe-like forearms capable of slicing through reinforced steel. Flight speed exceeds 80 km/h indoors, allowing rapid ambush attacks.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Predatory and silent. Displays advanced hunting instincts and strategic movement.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0123-A: SCP-0123 severed a containment drone in a single strike.
Addendum 0123-B: Wingbeat frequency suggests partial cloaking during rapid movement.

pokemon_scp.name: Jynx
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0124 is to be contained in a cold-resistant humanoid chamber with psychic dampeners. Personnel must avoid prolonged eye contact.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0124 emits low-frequency psychic waves through rhythmic movement. Skin temperature remains below freezing, and physical contact induces rapid hypothermia.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Expressive and emotional. Attempts to mimic human behavior.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0124-A: SCP-0124’s psychic rhythm caused mild hallucinations.
Addendum 0124-B: Frost buildup observed on containment walls after extended activity.

pokemon_scp.name: Electabuzz
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0125 is to be contained in a reinforced Faraday vault with triple-layer grounding. Personnel must wear insulated suits during interaction.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0125 generates electrical discharges exceeding 60,000 volts. Body emits constant static buildup capable of disrupting electronics.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Agitated and territorial. Electrical output spikes during aggression.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0125-A: SCP-0125 caused a facility-wide blackout.
Addendum 0125-B: Static buildup ignited nearby flammable materials.

pokemon_scp.name: Magmar
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0126 is to be contained in a heat-shielded volcanic vault with flame-dampening systems. Personnel must maintain a minimum distance of 20 meters.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0126’s body temperature exceeds 1,200°C. Emits flames capable of melting reinforced steel. Skin appears molten and shifts constantly.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive and unpredictable. Heat output increases when SCP-0126 is observed.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0126-A: SCP-0126 melted a containment gate during a rage event.
Addendum 0126-B: Thermal scans show internal magma-like flow.

pokemon_scp.name: Pinsir
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0127 is to be contained in a reinforced entomological vault with hydraulic restraints. Personnel must avoid proximity to SCP-0127’s horns.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0127 possesses horn-like mandibles capable of exerting crushing force exceeding industrial presses. Displays rapid lunging behavior.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive and territorial. Attempts to pin and crush targets.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0127-A: SCP-0127 crushed a titanium block during testing.
Addendum 0127-B: Mandible force increases during mating cycles.

pokemon_scp.name: Tauros
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0128 is to be contained in a titan-grade livestock vault with shock-absorbent barriers. Personnel must avoid SCP-0128’s charge path.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0128 is a large bovine organism capable of generating shockwaves through high-speed charges. Tail movement correlates with aggression levels.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Highly aggressive. Displays herd-like dominance behavior even when isolated.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0128-A: SCP-0128 shattered a reinforced barrier during a charge.
Addendum 0128-B: Shockwave output increases when SCP-0128 is observed directly.

pokemon_scp.name: Magikarp
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0129 is to be contained in a shallow aquatic enclosure. Personnel may interact with SCP-0129 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0129 is a weak aquatic organism capable of rapid flailing. Displays surprising resilience despite low physical strength.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Docile and harmless. Frequently leaps without clear purpose.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0129-A: SCP-0129 survived a fall that should have been fatal.
Addendum 0129-B: Flailing produced water patterns resembling Morse code.

pokemon_scp.name: Gyarados
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0130 cannot be reliably contained. Partial containment relies on deep-ocean isolation protocols and emergency naval response units.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0130 is a massive serpentine organism capable of generating storms, tidal waves, and high-pressure water blasts. Displays extreme aggression and intelligence comparable to apex predators.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Uncontrollable and destructive. Shows awareness of containment attempts and responds with overwhelming force.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0130-A: SCP-0130 generated a storm system that disrupted satellite monitoring.
Addendum 0130-B: Water blast severed a reinforced submarine hull.
